name: puppeteer
title: Puppeteer (promise API)
doc: Puppeteer-style adapter over xcelerate (camelCase, promise-based). Complete Browser + BrowserContext + Page + ElementHandle surface; methods xcelerate cannot express yet are emitted as explicit NotImplementedError stubs. Reserved identifiers ($, $$, $eval, $$eval, $x) are exposed under Python-safe names.

BrowserContext.doc: Puppeteer-style browser context (modelled as browser + init scripts).

Frame.doc: Frame adapter (surface only; not obtainable from this runtime yet).

CDPSession.doc: A CDP session (thin wrapper over the page connection).

Coverage.doc: Coverage collector (thin wrapper over the page).

Keyboard.doc: Keyboard input (thin wrapper over the page).

Mouse.doc: Mouse input (thin wrapper over the page).

Touchscreen.doc: Touchscreen input (thin wrapper over the page).

Tracing.doc: Tracing (thin wrapper over the page session).
